platformScope: Windows x64 / GDScript / local stdio and authenticated HTTP; remote production qualification remains later

defectReplay.D10: PASS: run-only HTTP client cannot mutate a persistent Godot session through a direct tool or bridge RPC
defectReplay.remaining: D07-D09 remain EXPECTED_DEFECT for T09 and later tasks

contractsVerified: All 59 registered tools have explicit permission classifications; unknown tools and bridge methods fail closed even for admin
Read-only and run-only clients cannot call arbitrary Godot methods or state-writing bridge RPCs; execution-capable calls require run and write
PID, run ID, bridge session and persistent subscription operations reject a second HTTP client; run and subscription lists hide foreign objects
A persistent subscription records its client owner and can be resumed by a new HTTP MCP session of that same client
Nested scenario project and screenshot step paths, repair edit paths, top-level screenshot/diff paths and bridge screenshot params are bounded
Canonical parent resolution rejects a directory link escaping an approved root, including with admin scope
HTTP Godot executables and bridge scripts require server-approved exact paths; client-selected extraArgs are disabled
Local stdio uses explicit scopes, roots and approved Godot/bridge entrypoints; it does not grant admin by default
Repair tickets remain private to one MCP server/session coordinator
limitations: This is not an OS sandbox: granting both run and write authorizes execution of project code as the service user
Overlapping evidenceRoots intentionally allow shared raw evidence reads; configure non-overlapping roots for confidentiality
Filesystem TOCTOU and complete project resource resolution remain T09/T10 work
One earlier parallel full-suite run had a transient protocol test FORBIDDEN result; isolated rerun and the final full baseline passed, but the concurrency cause is not established
G1 must run separately after T08 is marked done; this task evidence alone does not qualify production
Raw runs are Git-ignored and must be rerun if unavailable after migration
